description: Source code for the 'Variable' delivery limitation plugin class in Revive Adserver, handling data validation, display, and data expansion/compilation for site-specific variables.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLimitations_Site_Variable
classes.description: A plugin class for site-specific variable delivery limitations, extending comma-separated data handling, with methods for validation, display, and data processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting delimiter, operations, and name.

methods.name: checkInputData
methods.description: Validates input data, ensuring no unallowed characters in the variable name.

methods.name: displayArrayData
methods.description: Outputs HTML form elements for editing the variable name and value.

methods.name: _expandData
methods.description: Expands a stored string into an array of variable name and value.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Prepares data for storage by escaping and formatting.

methods.name: _preCompile
methods.description: Prepares data for compilation, trimming and preprocessing the variable name and value.
